subject: Web Development
title: GPU Acceleration
description: A short lesson to help you apply GPU Acceleration.

hook.text: Your computer has two processors that can draw: the CPU and the GPU.

buildup.text: CPUs handle general tasks. GPUs are built for parallel pixel math — perfect for rendering.

discovery.text: Browsers offload transforms, opacity, and compositing to the GPU for silky performance.

twist.text: Promoting too many elements to GPU layers wastes memory and can actually slow things down.

climax.text: The art is knowing which elements benefit from the GPU and which should stay on the CPU.

punchline.text: Two processors share the work of one page.

quiz.question: What is the GPU especially good at?
